text_block_list.text:
"Haru Urara took 1st place. However, she 
immediately rushes her Trainer to head 
back to training camp."

Though she says she's happy enough to 
dance, she's holding back her joy in order 
to stay hungry and claim even more 
1st-place victories.

Furthermore, Haru Urara requested to run 
in more GⅠ races. In order to grant her 
wish, the Trainer—

She decided to enter the JBC Sprint, a 
short-distance dirt course right up her 
alley.
